title: Stabilization theorem and symmetric structure of Cuntz--Pimsner algebras
summary: We establish a crossed product decomposition theorem for stabilized Cuntz--Pimsner algebras. This extends Cuntz's classical decomposition for Cuntz algebras and reveals an implicit symmetric structure within these algebras. Exploiting this structure, we characterize their simplicity and classify their ideals, tracial weights, and KMS weights for generalized quasi-free flows, revisiting and refining seminal results by Kitamura, Schweizer, and Laca--Neshveyev. We also give a short, elementary solution to the reduced Hao--Ng isomorphism problem for locally compact groups in full generality.…
